hero.subtitle: You tell us who to surprise and when. We handle every detail — flowers, cake, decor, venue — and deliver a moment they'll never forget.

occasions.title: We plan surprises for every occasion

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: Call or WhatsApp us with who you want to surprise, the occasion, and when. Our team guides you through the rest.
how.step2Body: We source the cake, flowers, decorations, venue setup and more — you don't lift a finger. We confirm when it's all ready.
how.step3Body: Your person walks into a moment they never saw coming. We handle the setup. You take all the credit.

packages.title: Every budget, every dream
packages.subtitle: All packages include our full planning and coordination service. A 25% deposit confirms your booking.

basic.description: A warm, heartfelt surprise for the people who matter most.

standard.name: Standard
standard.description: Everything in Basic, elevated with more detail and a bigger wow.

premium.name: Premium
premium.description: A full luxury experience — the kind of surprise they talk about for years.
